newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease, seen tracking sideways.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease, seen tracking sideways.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.37 percent on Wednesday as market participants balanced their books and traders forecast activity would slow towards year-end.
"I expect turnovers to decline as usual in December, but no dramatic price moves," said Miha Dolinar of Nova Ljubljanska Banka.
* The 10-share SBI index fell 4.45 points to 1,184.5.
* Drug maker Lek A issue was the most actively traded, rising 0.10 percent to 20,020 tolars on volume of 3,525 shares.
* Overall eight shares fell, six rose and two were unchanged, while nine were untraded.
